reasoning_content: Let's check the installed version of drupal/geocoder. The `geocoder.throttle` service might only be defined in a newer version of the module. Let's check what's installed.

action.command: grep -rn "throttle" /workspace/web/modules/contrib/geocoder/*.yml 2>/dev/null; echo "==="; grep -m2 "version" /workspace/web/modules/contrib/geocoder/geocoder.info.yml; echo "==="; grep -rn "throttle" /workspace/vendor/willdurand/geocoder/composer.json 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls /workspace/web/modules/contrib/geocoder/ | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "grep -rn \"throttle\" /workspace/web/modules/contrib/geocoder/*.yml 2>/dev/null; echo \"===\"; grep -m2 \"version\" /workspace/web/modules/contrib/geocoder/geocoder.info.yml; echo \"===\"; grep -rn \"throttle\" /workspace/vendor/willdurand/geocoder/composer.json 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls /workspace/web/modules/contrib/geocoder/ | head", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check installed geocoder module services"}
